$comment: Coverage fixture catalog for test/sync-rule-tables.test.mjs. Not a real shard. Every root under coverage/ carries this file byte-for-byte; the roots differ only in their standards/ documents.

rules.title: Fixture: a spend cap is declared
rules.description: The only rule for fixture Standard 95, whose rules live in one shard.
rules.rationale: Standard 95 therefore requires exactly one block: rules/cost.json.
rules.remediation: None; this is a test fixture.

rules.title: Fixture: the spend cap is enforced
rules.description: Fixture Standard 96's rule in rules/cost.json; its other rules are in rules/fairness.json.
rules.rationale: Standard 96 spans two shards, so it requires two blocks.
rules.remediation: None; this is a test fixture.

rules.title: Fixture: a rule for a standard with no document
rules.description: Belongs to fixture Standard 99, which no root under coverage/ writes.
rules.rationale: A rule citing an unwritten standard is permitted under the phased plan and requires no block.
rules.remediation: None; this is a test fixture.
